name: Claude Fable 5.1
description: Claude Fable 5.1 is Anthropic's successor to Claude Fable 5. It is currently available through Phaseo using the direct Anthropic provider.

details.name: data_retention
details.value: 30 days; unavailable under zero data retention unless expressly authorized

details.name: tool_choice
details.value: Supports auto and none. Forced any or named-tool selection is not supported.

details.name: availability
details.value: Claude Fable 5.1 is enabled through the direct Anthropic provider. Anthropic also confirms availability on Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry; Phaseo tracks those mappings as supported but non-routable pending provider-specific IDs, regions, and pricing verification.
